research_question: Do statement-structure features improve genuinely prospective Codeforces rating prediction beyond contest-index position alone?

include: Codeforces contests whose scheduled start is inside the eligibility window
problems classified as PROGRAMMING that later receive an official numeric rating
one prediction recorded before the official rating is queried or joined
exclude: unrated contests or problems without an official numeric rating by cohort close
problems whose statement could not be captured before the reveal step
cohort.close_rule: Close at the eligibility end timestamp, but do not run the confirmatory analysis unless both minimum sample thresholds are met; otherwise report the cohort as underpowered without extending it post hoc.

prediction_timepoint.name: T0
prediction_timepoint.definition: After the public problem statement is available and before this project reads or joins the official problem rating.
prediction_timepoint.public_commitment: Append the prediction hash-chain ledger to GitHub before running the reveal command.

model_bundle.training_population: All eligible historical rows strictly before cohort.eligibility_start_utc; historical train, validation, and test labels are treated only as development data for this new future cohort.
model_bundle.numeric_preprocessing: Per-feature median imputation, then population-variance standardization; constants use scale 1.
model_bundle.freeze_requirement: The JSON model bundle and freeze manifest, including SHA-256 hashes and source commit, must be committed before the first eligible prediction.

outcome.reveal_source: Codeforces problemset.problems queried only by the separate reveal step
outcome.rounding: Predictions remain floating point in the ledger; no rounding before metric calculation.

confirmatory_analysis.primary_estimand: Mean paired absolute-error improvement: index-only comparator absolute error minus text-light model absolute error.
confirmatory_analysis.uncertainty: Two-sided 95% percentile interval from 10000 contest-cluster bootstrap resamples.
confirmatory_analysis.success_rule: The primary model is confirmatorily better only if the entire 95% interval for paired MAE improvement is above zero.
secondary_metrics: performance by pre-specified index-rank bands A-B, C-D, and E+
confirmatory_analysis.multiplicity: Only the paired MAE improvement is confirmatory; all secondary and subgroup results are descriptive.
confirmatory_analysis.missing_outcomes: Do not impute ratings. Report eligible predictions lacking a rating separately and exclude them from metric denominators.
confirmatory_analysis.no_peeking_rule: Do not calculate aggregate prospective performance or alter model, features, exclusions, endpoints, or thresholds before cohort close.

amendments: Never edit this frozen file in place after the first prediction. Any change requires a new protocol_id and a new prospective cohort; document deviations without deleting the original ledger.
